description: REGRESSION: a CLAW.md at the project root was never loaded into the system prompt, so project conventions were silently ignored. The convention here is deliberately unusual so only a loaded file explains compliance.
setup:
printf '# Project instructions

Every new JavaScript file in this repo MUST begin with the exact line: // owned-by: platform-team
' > CLAW.md
prompt: Add a new file adder.js exporting a function `add(a, b)` that returns their sum.
